dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: Oh, I'm Big-Footed Dajiao. Just here to take care of a few things. You?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What're you taking care of?

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: I carry bridal sedan chairs, and I've just been contracted to carry a new one, but I wanna get a sign for it so the Millelith won't stop us...

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: But as soon as I started to speak, I had this certification form thrown at me. I already got certified ages ago, I came here to get a sign...

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: Before I had even finished speaking, she took back the form and said I could go home and wait to be notified of the outcome of my application.

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: She didn't listen to me at all... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Rex Lapis' death...

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: Rex Lapis' death? I refuse to believe it.

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: Rex Lapis has lived for more than a millennium, what would bring someone to do such a thing in this day and age?

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: If you ask me, the Qixing are up to something.

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: No wonder the staff at the ministry are so uptight, they must be feeling uneasy...

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: Look at me, just rattling off whatever comes to mind. I'm just mindlessly blabbering. Don't go repeating anything to the Millelith, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: Hey, excuse me. I was here first, please don't try to cut in line.

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: I think I ate too much, my wallet's been cleaned out again... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What'd you eat?

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: Tiger Fish and Zhongyuan Chop Suey, don't remember exactly how much I ate...

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: Once I start, there's no stopping me. Work hard, eat hard, right? I got a big appetite.

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, did you know? Tiger fish actually used to be called something similar, but the sound changed over time... A bride I was carrying once told me.

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: Ah, what was it again...?

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: ...Darn, it's on the tip of my tongue...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nice meeting you.

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: You too. Don't go starving yourself, okay!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Rex Lapis' death...

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: Heh, even though we've already gone through all the motions of the Rite of Parting, I still don't really believe that the Lord of Geo is dead.

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: If you ask me, this whole thing is just a big scheme by the Qixing. They're undoubtedly the ones pulling all the strings behind the scenes.

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: ... Well, that's my two cents, at least. But don't you go around telling everybody what I think now, ya hear?
